findings.summary: Wrong noun for 'chat'. The glossary renders chat as 对话 (temporary chat → 临时对话) and shipped zh-CN says 对话 646 times against 聊天 15 (mostly 聊天机器人, a header preview). The identical en strings ship as 打开对话 (ui.library.composer.open_chat), 新对话 (ui.chat.header.new_chat) and 未命名对话 (ui.chat.canonical.untitled). The translator used 聊天 throughout (打开聊天, 新聊天, 无标题聊天, 该聊天…), which would put two words for one thing in the same toast/composer (e.g. 'Open chat' next to the sidebar's 新对话). All twelve affected values changed 聊天/无标题聊天 → 对话/未命名对话; wording otherwise untouched.
